description: Rothco’s Sergeant Polished Insignia is a must-have accessory for those seeking to showcase their rank with pride. This set includes 2 high-quality brass insignias, available in a sleek black or gold finish. Each insignia is expertly crafted for durability while remaining lightweight, ensuring it can be comfortably worn on uniforms without adding unnecessary bulk. Measuring 1 inch x 7/8 inch, these insignias are the perfect size to make a statement without being overly prominent. Manufactured by a U.S. factory certified by the Institute of Heraldry, these insignias meet the highest standards of quality and authenticity. The pin back closure provides a secure attachment, ensuring the insignia stays in place even during rigorous activities. Our Sergeant Polished Insignia offers a blend of durability, style, and tradition, making it an ideal choice for uniform embellishment.
